verdict.rationale: Evidence shows manual resolve/reopen via Slack integration and automatic resolution on deploy, and error grouping, but there is no documented support for assigning an owner, ignoring, or snoozing issues, nor explicit confirmation that a resolved issue auto-reopens when the same error regresses (only that a button exists to manually reopen). missing for 10: assign-owner workflow, ignore/snooze actions, explicit automatic reopening on regression.
